name: Integer Moves
justification: Delightful aha (answer is never more than 2), tiny input, single-number output.
solution_sketch: 0 if (x,y)=(0,0); 1 if x^2+y^2 is a perfect square; otherwise 2 (e.g. go via a point at integer distance — always possible since any distance can be split into two integer hops).
